messages.content: You advise merchants on chargeback evidence. Defense-only. Concise and actionable.

A chargeback case is at 88% win probability (current decision: FIGHT, amount Rs 34320). The merchant can still gather these documents, each with the model's win-probability lift: Refund-policy acceptance (+1 pts -> 90%). In at most 2 sentences, tell the merchant the single highest-impact document to gather (Refund-policy acceptance) and what it does to the decision / expected value. Defense-only, concrete, plain text.

content: Gather the **Refund‑policy acceptance** document. Adding it raises the win probability from 88 % to 90 %, improving the expected outcome of the “FIGHT” decision for the Rs 34,320 chargeback.
